mechanism: Tranylcypromine is an irreversible MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase; valerian may contain serotonergic compounds and CNS depressants, creating risk for serotonin syndrome and excessive CNS depression.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if valerian is necessary for sleep, use lowest dose with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and excessive sedation.
